description:
IRREVERSIBLE: Delete an integration

Removes the integration and the credentials stored with it. When an account of the service was connected through the dashboard for this integration, that connection is removed as well, unless another integration still uses it; this happens on a best-effort basis and never blocks the delete. This cannot be undone, and any agent that was assigned this integration loses the ability to perform its actions from the moment of deletion: its assignments to agents and chatbots are removed and their tool lists rebuilt at once. To stop use of an integration temporarily while keeping its configuration, set `isActive` to false with a PATCH instead. Deleting a Genesys Cloud integration also ends its running calls, a call can take up to a minute to end, and its access data stop working at once.

confirm.description: Leave out on the first call. EchoCall then answers with a confirmation value. Ask the user for a clear yes, then repeat the call with the same arguments and this value.
